mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite inflation signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite weakening demand signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite labor market weakness signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite supply chain disruption signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with subsequent production slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5%, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite economic weakness signal, or the combined signal does not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 60% of instances despite easing signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent positive equity performance.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite tight labor market signal, or the combined signal does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite economic expansion signal, or GDPC1 increase does not correlate with subsequent equity market strength.
